title: Real SQLite local connector for Issue 77
intent: Keep PR 78 local-only: replace the handwritten JSON snapshot, parser, journal, and pure-Rust importer with a real SQLite connector that opens existing SQLite files unchanged, preserves the backend-neutral public API, proves parameterized values/constraints/read-only/atomic/schema behavior, and leaves Neon/Propodus hosting policy outside Dactyl.
proof_hooks: cargo fmt --check; cargo test --all-features; cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo tree --features sqlite; decapod validate
stop_conditions: Do not change Neon behavior in this PR; track Neon and Propodus parity separately.
